posts.what: Lumi's shadow detaches as a flat dark bird, runs across the meadow, dodges Lumi three times while Lumi chases and shouts, then Lumi pounces and it slides back under its feet.
posts.recipe: Lumi-only chase of a single object with dodges, then a catch; friends only gasp in passing; playable with V
posts.shared: Lumi-centred solo event with a comic setback and payoff; resembles the paint fight/bubble chase only loosely (a runaway thing Lumi must catch); no gathering or crowd
